Friday Brewery Gravel Trail Ride (Sussex Cyclists)

Lewes, DE · Gravel · Social

Beginner friendly

Friday Brewery Gravel Trail Ride (Sussex Cyclists) is a gravel and social group ride in Lewes, DE. It rolls every Friday at 10:00 am from Lewes Brewery Company (most weeks). About 21–26 miles, 13 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 13 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Friday Brewery Gravel Trail Ride (Sussex Cyclists) group ride

An easy-paced Friday ride on the trails around Lewes and Rehoboth, about 21 to 26 miles at 13 mph. It starts and ends at a brewery. Most weeks that is Lewes Brewery Company, but it moves around, so check the club calendar.
